title: SugarCraft — SugarInput
description: SugarInput: Terminal escape sequence decoder — legacy keys (incl. modified xterm forms), Kitty keyboard protocol, SGR 1006/1016 + urxvt 1015 + X10 mouse, focus events, bracketed paste. The input layer PHP TUIs have been missing.
ogDescription: EscapeDecoder consumes raw TTY bytes and emits typed Events. Supports legacy keys, Kitty keyboard protocol, xterm modifyOtherKeys, SGR 1006/1016, urxvt 1015 and X10 mouse, focus events, and bracketed paste. Native PHP — decoding semantics follow charmbracelet/bubbletea.
detailMeta: native PHP — semantics follow bubbletea input input foundation-package
